name: Boneless Lantern
description: Boneless lanterns originated in the Tang Dynasty, with unique shapes, small and exquisite shapes. The lamp body has no skeleton and is made entirely of paper pasted with various patterns embroidered with embroidery needles. It is light and can fly. Pinku inherits the intangible cultural heritage culture and uses 3D metal puzzles to interpret the boneless lanterns to pay tribute to the ingenuity of the intangible cultural heritage.
